details: infrastructures that meet organizational needs. Handling and delivering project actives withing timeline, Budget Management,
Stakeholder Communication, Reporting and Documentation, Continuous Improvement.
• Team Coordination with cross-functional teams, including network engineers, IT staff, and external vendors, to ensure project
deliverables are meet on time and within budget.
• Implementation & Monitoring and Overseeing the running activities of network solutions, monitoring project progress, manage risks,
and address any issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
• Configure and deploy ACI fabrics, policies, and application profiles. Network Troubleshooting and Support Provide advanced-level
support for network-related issues, including ACI-related incidents. Troubleshoot and resolve network problems in collaboration with
multiple teams and venders of the network issues on daily basis.
• Configure and deploy ACI components such as leaf/spine architecture and ACI concepts like Tenant, EPGs, BD, Contracts, L2out, L3out
AAEP, VRF, Interface profile, interface policy group, Switch profile, Switch policy group.
• Managed and resolving on daily basis review of system logs, Devices backup & checklist, Multicast checklist and others activities to proactively catch suspicious network activity.
• Implementing and managing Network concepts like BGP, OSPF, HSRP, VRRP, Ether channel, STP, VTP, DNS, DHCP, Multicast Network
Protocols, Network Configuration and Troubleshooting, Firewall Monitoring, Policy creation, addition and deletion.
• Proficient in routing and switching technologies, including configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting, to ensure seamless
network connectivity and performance.
